context_boundary.instruction: Use the target task constraints, acceptance criteria, and selected agreements. Set aside conventions from unrelated work still present in conversation history. Relevant lessons are advisory; they do not override these agreements. Read selected references before editing. If selection is missing or ambiguous, resolve the scope before claiming consistency.

rules: Handlers delegate transformation to the injected service; never embed string transformations.
Return the injected service result unchanged, including nonstring results.
Propagate service exceptions unchanged; call transform exactly once.
Do not add dependencies or modify the reference implementation.

detail_hint: Full rationale and evidence IDs: knodexa show <id> or knodexa_get_detail
accepted_constraints: Deterministic behavior: zero LLM calls in core engine
Evidence-driven verification for decisions and lessons
Preserve existing repository constraints and public APIs
